name: Etude Showcase
description: One card per idea, each showing something a normal flashcard app can't do: cards you play, drag, hear, draw, code and derive in, graded by scripts that actually check the work, with fresh variants every review.

decks.name: Etude Showcase
decks.description: A tour of what Etude cards can be. Every card is a different exhibit.
decks.instructions: This is a demo deck. Grade fairly: right ideas in different words are correct.

decks.name: Etude Showcase::1 Answer anything
decks.description: Code that runs, math checked for equivalence, proofs in live LaTeX, drawings read by a vision model.

decks.name: Etude Showcase::2 Math and science
decks.description: Drag, fit and tune: geometry and functions you manipulate directly.

decks.name: Etude Showcase::3 Computing
decks.description: Regexes run against tests, traces, traversals and bugs you point at.

decks.name: Etude Showcase::6 Languages
decks.description: Write characters by hand; a vision model reads your strokes.
